summary.text: Ken Helm is a Democratic member of the Oregon House of Representatives for House District 27, which his legislative page lists as Beaverton and Cedar Hills.
He is an attorney with a background in land use law.

paragraphs.text: Helm grew up in Oregon and graduated from high school in Bend before earning a B.A. in history and political science from Willamette University.
After working as a baker for a couple of years, he returned to Willamette University College of Law for his J.D. and began his land use career clerking for the Oregon Land Use Board of Appeals.
In 1997 he took a position with the land use staff at Metro, the regional government that manages the Portland-area urban growth boundary.
Before joining the legislature, he ran his own solo law practice, where one of his main practice areas was serving as a land use and code enforcement hearings officer for cities and counties.
